name: PixiTween Director S13b: 3D in the director, the crew and the studio (three-way mode decision)
description: Teach the director and the crew to choose motion, 3d or generate per scene and explain why; make motion and 3d swap for free; show the mode in the UI with a three-way toggle; pass the engine's model3d readiness and errors through the Player so capture and export wait for 3D; a check page, a fake-mode 3D scene for e2e, the live gate and docs/3d.md.

userStories.title: Storyboard: mode '3d' and productShape
userStories.description: As a director, I want a third mode and the product's packaging shape in the storyboard so that 3D is a first-class choice.
steps: Read shared/storyboard.ts, server/agent/storyboard.ts (SPARK_STORYBOARD_SCHEMA, normaliseStoryboard) and design.md section 5.1.
Edit shared/storyboard.ts: sceneSchema.mode adds '3d'; storyboardSchema adds productShape?: 'can' | 'bottle' | 'box' | 'jar' | 'tube' | 'pouch' | 'other'.

Edit server/agent/storyboard.ts: the JSON schema's mode enum adds '3d' and the root gains productShape; normaliseStoryboard keeps '3d' only when PRODUCT_3D is true and productShape is present, otherwise demotes it to motion with ' (3d off)' or ' (no product shape)' appended to modeReason.
Extend server/agent/storyboard.test.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: With PRODUCT_3D=true, a raw storyboard with productShape 'can' and a '3d' scene keeps mode '3d'
With PRODUCT_3D=false the same scene becomes 'motion' and its modeReason ends with '(3d off)'

userStories.title: Storyboard and builder prompts: the three-way rule
userStories.description: As a director, I want a clear rule for motion, 3d and generate so that my choice is consistent and explained.
steps: Read server/agent/prompts/director.ts and design.md sections 5.1 and 6.

Edit server/agent/prompts/director.ts: the storyboard prompt gains the three-way rule and the productShape instruction from design section 6 when PRODUCT_3D is true; the scene-builder prompt for a '3d' scene says to draw the plate, cut out the product, then call placeProduct3D instead of placing a 2D product, and to keep headline z larger than the product when the text should sit behind it.
Extend the prompt tests with snapshot checks for both flag values.
acceptanceCriteria: With PRODUCT_3D=true the storyboard prompt contains 'Use 3d when the shot is about the product itself turning'
With PRODUCT_3D=false the storyboard prompt does not contain the word '3d'
The builder prompt for a scene with mode '3d' contains 'placeProduct3D'

userStories.title: Edit prompt examples for turning and lighting
userStories.description: As a user chatting, I want 'turn it more' and 'light from the window' understood so that 3D edits feel instant.
steps: Read server/agent/edit-prompt.ts.

Edit server/agent/edit-prompt.ts: when the selected or mentioned scene has a model3d layer, add the two examples of design section 6 (turnProduct sway 30; lightProduct preset 'window') and the sentence 'Turning is limited to 35 degrees each way because only the front of the product was photographed.'
Extend server/agent/edit-loop.test.ts with a fake backend script that calls turnProduct.
acceptanceCriteria: For a film whose s1 has s1:product3d, buildEditMessages includes 'turnProduct' in the system text; for a 2D-only film it does not
A scripted edit calling turnProduct with to 30 commits one new version with source 'chat'

userStories.title: Showrunner rule: the cheapest technique that tells the shot
userStories.description: As a showrunner, I want the three-way rule in my prompt so that I explain motion, 3d and generate choices to the user.
steps: Read server/crew/prompts.ts (SHOWRUNNER_SYSTEM rule 3) and design.md section 5.1.

Edit server/crew/prompts.ts: when PRODUCT_3D is true, rule 3 becomes the three-way rule: 'Pick the cheapest technique that tells the shot: motion for most shots; 3d when the product itself turns, catches the light or is revealed and it is rigid packaging (free, editable); proposeGenerate only for physics a still cannot fake (pouring, hands, fabric, walking).'
Extend server/crew/prompts.test.ts for both flag values.
acceptanceCriteria: With PRODUCT_3D=true SHOWRUNNER_SYSTEM (as built by its function) contains 'Pick the cheapest technique that tells the shot'
With PRODUCT_3D=false rule 3 is exactly the S12b text

userStories.title: Mode route: free motion <-> 3d swap
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch a scene between motion and 3D at no cost so that I can compare the two instantly.
steps: Read server/generate/mode.ts, server/http/handlers/generate.ts, design.md section 5.6 and server/tools/product3d.ts.

Edit server/generate/mode.ts and server/http/handlers/generate.ts: accept mode '3d' when PRODUCT_3D is true; motion -> 3d runs prepareProduct3D and placeProduct3D at the 2D product's box inside one mutate; 3d -> motion removes the product3d layer and restores a 2D product image layer from the cut-out at the same box; 3d -> generate goes through motion first. Each swap emits tool.call and updates the storyboard scene's mode and modeReason ('switched by you').
Extend server/generate/mode.test.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /scenes/s1/mode { mode: '3d' } returns 200, makes zero Meta calls and the composition has s1:product3d
Switching back to 'motion' restores s1:product with a transform deep-equal to the original

userStories.title: UI: mode tags and the three-way toggle
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want to see which scenes are Motion, 3D or Generate and switch them so that the director's choice is visible and mine to change.
steps: Read web/src/panels/ModeToggle.tsx, web/src/panels/Storyboard.tsx and web/src/crew/SceneCard.tsx.
Edit web/src/panels/ModeToggle.tsx: three segments Motion / 3D / Generate (3D only when the health or film payload says product3d is enabled); 3D posts mode '3d'; Generate keeps the S7 proposal flow.
Edit web/src/panels/Storyboard.tsx and web/src/crew/SceneCard.tsx: show a '3D' tag with the modeReason tooltip for mode '3d'.
Extend the ModeToggle and SceneCard tests.
acceptanceCriteria: With product3d enabled, ModeToggle renders three options and clicking 3D posts { mode: '3d' } for that scene
With product3d disabled, ModeToggle renders the two options it renders today
A scene with mode '3d' shows the tag text '3D' on its card
Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`

userStories.title: Player passes model3d readiness and errors through
userStories.description: As a capture and export, I want to know when every 3D layer has drawn so that I never grab a frame without the product.
steps: Read web/src/player/Player.tsx and the installed engine's AepComposition props (node_modules/reacthub-pixitweenjs/dist/components/AepComposition/AepComposition.d.ts) for onRenderReady and onLayerError. Note onReady only means the JSON parsed; the render signal is onRenderReady (or useAepCompositionReady()).
Create web/src/player/useCompositionReady.ts: tracks ready (true at once for a composition with no model3d layer) and exposes whenReady(timeoutMs): Promise<boolean>.
Edit web/src/player/Player.tsx: pass onRenderReady and onLayerError when the engine supports them, add whenReady to PlayerHandle, and report layer errors through an onError prop.
Add web/src/player/useCompositionReady.test.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: For a composition without model3d, whenReady(10) resolves true immediately
For one with model3d, whenReady resolves true after the engine's onRenderReady fires, and false after the timeout when it never fires (fake timers)
Against an engine without onRenderReady, the Player still renders and whenReady resolves true (feature check)

userStories.title: Capture and export wait for 3D
userStories.description: As a critic and export, I want to wait for the 3D product to be drawn so that frames always include it.
steps: Read web/src/capture/index.ts, web/src/export/index.ts and web/src/player/useCompositionReady.ts.
Edit web/src/capture/index.ts: before the first seek, await player.whenReady(10000); if false, continue and include { model3dNotReady: true } in the posted metadata.
Edit web/src/export/index.ts: await player.whenReady(20000) before recording; if false, stop with the message 'The 3D product did not finish loading; try again.'
Extend the capture and export tests with a fake handle.
acceptanceCriteria: capture awaits whenReady before its first seek (call order recorded by the fake handle)
export with whenReady resolving false never starts the recorder and shows the stated message

userStories.title: three-check page with the fixture can
userStories.description: As a owner, I want one page that shows the 3D can with its label, sway, light and shadow so that I can judge the look before a live run.
steps: Read web/clip-check.html and its entry (the existing check page pattern) and fixtures/s13a/valid-model3d.json.

Create web/three-check.html and web/src/dev/three-check.tsx: plays a two-scene fixture film (fixtures/s13b/three-check.json, built with placeProduct3D on the test can label, a plate and a headline behind the product) with buttons for the four lighting presets and sway 18 / 35, and shows the engine version.
Create fixtures/s13b/three-check.json and its small PNG assets (test images from server/product3d/test-images.ts).
acceptanceCriteria: Browser check with engine 0.3.0-alpha.5: the can turns between -18 and 18 degrees, the headline is hidden behind it in the middle of the sway, and a shadow shows on the plate
Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`

userStories.title: Fake-mode 3D scene and the e2e check
userStories.description: As a tester, I want the fake director and fake crew to make one 3D scene so that the 3D path is rehearsed offline.
steps: Read server/agent/fake-director.ts, server/crew/fake-showrunner.ts and e2e/crew.spec.ts.
Edit server/agent/fake-director.ts: when PRODUCT_3D is true, the fake storyboard sets productShape 'can' and scene s1 mode '3d', and the fake builder for s1 calls placeProduct3D.

Edit e2e/crew.spec.ts: with PRODUCT_3D=true, assert the s1 card shows the '3D' tag and the composition has s1:product3d (via GET /api/films/:id); the canvas pixel check is fixme on engines older than 0.3.0-alpha.5.
acceptanceCriteria: A fake director run with PRODUCT_3D=true ends 'ready' with s1:product3d in the composition
e2e/crew.spec.ts asserts the '3D' tag on the s1 card

userStories.title: Live script s13-3d
userStories.description: As a owner, I want one command that makes a real film with a 3D hero so that I can score the look with real art.
steps: Read scripts/live/s03-director.ts and scripts/live/run.ts.

Create scripts/live/s13-3d.ts: describe(), estimateUsd() returning 0.4, run(): checks PRODUCT_3D is true and the installed engine is at least 0.3.0-alpha.5 (exits with a message otherwise), runs a film on the Coffee Co. product photo with a brief that asks for a hero reveal of the can, waits for ready, and prints each scene's mode and modeReason, the model3d layer ids, cost, and the URL of three-check-style frames to capture.
Add scripts/live/s13-3d.test.ts for describe and estimateUsd and the version check (no network).
acceptanceCriteria: run() with PRODUCT_3D false exits non-zero with a message naming PRODUCT_3D before any request

userStories.title: docs/3d.md
userStories.description: As a judge, I want a short explanation of the 3D product shots so that I can see what is new and how the label stays true.
steps: Read docs/hackathon/steps/step-13-product-3d/design.md and ~/Documents/code/trolio/reacthub-pixitweenjs/docs/director-uplift/02-model3d-layer/requirements.md.

Write docs/3d.md: the three-way decision table, how the label comes from the photo (unwrap, box, extrude, with a diagram), why turning stops at 35 degrees, what the engine's model3d layer does (one renderer, Pixi texture, frame-driven, shadow on the plate), what was rebuilt during the hackathon from our earlier editor experiment, and a 'Measured' section filled from MG-1 or marked 'to be measured'.
Add a check to scripts/live/s13-3d.test.ts that docs/3d.md has no link to docs/hackathon/ or docs/learn-improve/.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/3d.md contains the headings 'Motion, 3D or Generate', 'A label from the photo', 'Why 35 degrees', 'The model3d layer' and 'Measured'
docs/3d.md contains no link to docs/hackathon/ or docs/learn-improve/

metadata.standingRule: Offline-only PRD. Every story is implementable and verifiable with unit tests, recorded fixtures and the browser preview; nothing here spends money or needs network. Live and paid checks are listed in metadata.manualGates and run by the owner.
guardrails: Work offline. Tests use recorded fixtures and DIRECTOR_REPLAY=1. Never call Meta, Clippy, Ollama or any other network service from a story, a test or a script you run during a story. The only network use allowed is `npm install`.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.
For engine behaviour (composition JSON, Player, timeline, layer kinds) read docs/engine/README.md before writing code; never edit or copy engine source.

Never edit anything under node_modules/. The engine `reacthub-pixitweenjs` is a dependency: if it lacks something, add a row to ENGINE-NEEDS.md (what, where, proposed API, workaround, story) and use a workaround or set notes to 'blocked: engine'.
Edit only the files named in the story's steps, plus their tests. Files under shared/ are contracts (specs/hackathon/meta/06-contracts.md): change them only in a story that says so.
Never put keys, tokens, cookies or personal data in code, fixtures, logs or docs. Fixtures are redacted: no Authorization headers and no data: URLs longer than 200 characters.
No real brand names, logos or real people's likeness in prompts, fixtures or assets.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements, latencies, prices or test output.
Do not add a dependency that the story or 06-contracts.md does not name. If one is truly needed, say why in notes.
Debug output goes to debug/<step>/iteration-NN/ (gitignored). Only curated, redacted fixtures are committed, under fixtures/<step>/.

A step that would call a paid or live API is written as a script that prints an estimate and exits unless `--yes` is passed (`npm run live -- <step> --yes`, one file per step under scripts/live/). Create such scripts; never run them.
With PRODUCT_3D=false the product behaves exactly as before: no 3d mode offered, no 3D tools, existing tests unchanged.
The UI never claims a shot is 3D unless the scene's composition has a model3d layer.
Stories that need the engine's model3d layer in the browser check the installed engine version first; if it is older than 0.3.0-alpha.5, mark only the browser check as fixme and say so in notes.

ui: Verify in the browser (dev-browser skill or preview): `npm run dev`, open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, and record what you saw in `notes`

manualGates: MG-1: owner sets PRODUCT_3D=true with engine 0.3.0-alpha.5 installed, runs `npm run live -- s13-3d` (estimate about $0.40), then `--yes`: one Coffee Co. film whose hero scene is 3d. Record three frames (start, middle and end of the sway), the storyboard's modeReason for that scene, cost, and a realism score 1-5. Keep 3D in the demo only at 4 or above.
metadata.completion: S13b: built and tested 30 Oct 2026 (unit tests, a browser check on engine 0.3.0-alpha.5, crew e2e). Live gate MG-1 is the owner's.
